review.decision: Cover a refused early save before an authorized switch and the page-only bookmark fallback.
review.notes: Use a synthetic browser identity and controlled notification order. Render ordinary bookmark controls when persistent storage cannot accept new entries.

cases.description: A late pairing notification preserves unsaved edits on an authorized switch
cases.setup: An active draft and two synthetic credentials on the same workspace.
cases.action: Replace the stored pairing and run a timer or page-hide callback before delivering the change to the old view.
cases.expected: The pending change is saved in the old profile when the switch is processed, never in the new profile.

cases.description: A paired browser without writable storage can bookmark for this page
cases.setup: A synthetic paired conversation with stable turn IDs and unavailable persistent storage.
cases.action: Mark a turn, redraw the transcript and remove the mark.
cases.expected: The mark and page-only feedback survive the redraw, removal works, and no bookmark is persisted.
